log.note: Replaced Abnormal Security (MD: 'not good') and screened out Bridgestone (incoming sole FE tire supplier 2026-27 = deepest already_present; lost F1 tender; mature public incumbent, not our pre-IPO profile). Honest MODE-B fit: brand+audience+engineering adjacency, not an in-car deployment.

log.name: Infineon Technologies
log.note: Today's FE hero at the signal quality bar, built on the recalibrated electrical/electronics profile. Infineon = world #1 auto/power-semiconductor maker (~$17.2B rev, ~$120B cap), SiC leader. REAL in-car workstream: FE powertrains are manufacturer-developed, so SiC sits in Jaguar's traction inverter (the biggest lever on efficiency/thermal/regen) - not a halo. Verified decision PATH: CMO Andreas Urschitz -> CEO Jochen Hanebeck -> Automotive President Peter Schiefer. Screen-outs done: Eaton (FE-relevant eMobility being spun off/declining -> F1 fit), Porsche (TDK+Synopsys occupy electronics), Mahindra (Renesas). Jaguar power-semi lane OPEN. Gate 0 blockers, 2 pages. (Electra 68 + Watershed 70 + Vertiv 82/F1 also generated this day as bench options.)

log.note: Fri F1 hero. Cadence = computational-engineering leader; just acquired Hexagon's CFD/multiphysics/structural stack (MSC Nastran, Adams) - the literal toolchain F1 cars are designed with. REAL MODE-A workstream; greenfield Cadillac builds its CAE from zero (PRIME LANE). Decision path: SVP Mktg/BD Nimish Modi -> CEO Anirudh Devgan. 0 blockers, 2pp.

log.note: Sat F1 hero. Eaton = intelligent-power-management leader (record $27.4B FY25) on the electrification + AI-power supercycle; nVent electrical thread at scale, public. Real workstream: electrical backbone of Aston's new campus/wind-tunnel/sim + trackside; electrical lane OPEN. Decision path: CEO Paulo Ruiz + Marcomms Dir Camie Hanily. 0 blockers, 2pp.

log.note: FE hero (refreshed-bench pick, replacing GE Vernova which stays a bench prospect). Commonwealth Fusion Systems = MIT fusion leader (~$3B raised; $863M Series B2 Aug 2025; NVIDIA/Google/Breakthrough). Why-now: SPARC targets net energy gain Q1 2027 + Google 200MW PPA. HONEST: marquee brand/future-energy halo (fusion not team-deployable) - MODE-B, scored 71 WARM (ops_fit 11). Andretti (American, sustainability, charter) lane OPEN. Decision-maker CEO Bob Mumgaard. 0 blockers, 2pp.

log.name: Divergent Technologies
log.note: Sat F1 hero, replacing ElevenLabs (screened out — already_present: official Audi Revolut F1 AI partner since Jan 2026, the exact workstream pitched; the already_present gate is run FIRST now). Divergent = $2.3B AI additive-manufacturing leader ($290M Series E at $2.3B, Sep 2025; DAPS platform). REAL MODE-A workstream: AI-designed, 3D-printed lightweight structural components (suspension wishbones/uprights) under the cost cap — already PROVEN, as Divergent prints exactly these for the McLaren W1 hypercar. Grid-check run first: that tie is with McLaren AUTOMOTIVE (road cars), a SEPARATE company from McLaren Racing (F1) — so Divergent is grid-clean for F1, and the road-car work is an honest warm brand-family bridge, not an existing F1 deal. Additive-manufacturing lane on McLaren reads OPEN (0 conflicts/0 crowding). Decision-maker CEO Lukas Czinger. 0 blockers, 2pp, HOT 78.

log.name: GE Vernova
log.note: Mon FE hero. Engine #1 was Infineon (79) but it already shipped 06-16, so forced the never-featured GE Vernova for a fresh signal. Screen-out: Kraken (engine's recurring FE #1) flagged 'approached' — MD confirmed it's already in 1440's pipeline to chase (now gated out + logged in approached.json). GE Vernova = the ~$290B electrification/power pure-play GE spun out in 2024, FY26 revenue guidance raised to ~$45B, $163B backlog (Q1'26 rev +16%), riding the AI-data-centre power supercycle. Figures re-verified live today (stale ~$38B rev / ~$303B cap corrected; Koziner title corrected to Chief Commercial & Operations Officer). HONEST: MODE-B — GE Vernova builds no race-car tech, so the team workstream is clean event/paddock power + a sustainability story (off-car), scored 77 accordingly (ops_fit 13). Porsche electrification lane OPEN; decision path Pablo Koziner -> CEO Scott Strazik. 0 blockers, 2pp.
